runs.prompt: Expand this scene into one vivid video prompt, about 100 words. Describe camera movement, lighting and action. Output only the prompt. Scene: A small red sailboat crosses a misty mountain lake at sunrise.
runs.text: A slow, sweeping drone shot glides above a misty mountain lake at sunrise, capturing a tiny red sailboat gliding gracefully through the hazy water. Golden dawn light filters through the mist, casting ethereal reflections on the lake’s surface. The camera circles gently, revealing the boat’s vibrant red hull against the cool blues and grays of the landscape. Mist curls around the water’s edge, while distant peaks blush with sunrise. The sailboat’s crew leans slightly, adjusting the sail as gentle ripples ripple outward — a quiet, serene journey through nature’s awakening.

runs.text: In a sun-drenched, cluttered brass workshop, a master clockmaker, fingers dusted with fine metal shavings, delicately assembles a miniature mechanical bird. Golden gears click softly as he adjusts its wing hinges, sunlight streaming through high windows casting warm glows across his workbench. Tiny brass components gleam under the light, while scattered tools and clock parts whisper of decades of craftsmanship. The bird, barely the size of a thumb, breathes life with each precise movement — a tiny, ticking miracle in a world of ticking time.
